Shanghai Municipal Police.
C. I. D.

Date 16/4/17
CENTRAL POLICE Station.
16th April, 1917.
REPORT ON Li Tsung Woo.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
Li Tsung Woo (李徵五) still retains his residence at 368
Avenue Edward VII. He went to Nanking on the 11th instant and
has not yet returned. It is reported that he is visiting the
Vice President.
Your obedient servant,
Wm Brewster.
Detective Sub-Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.

CAPTAIN SUPERINTENDENT'S OFFICE.

Translation of printed circular.
191......
To Capt. Supt. of Police.
Please read this story of the crimes committed by a person
pretended to be a revolutionist.
On account of the abolition of the fallen Manchu dynasty
revolution broke out and soon transformed our country into a
republic. The original intention of this transformation was
for the benefit of social progress and also to get rid off the
bad persons and to comfort the good. Unexpectedly, during these
five years of the Republic, fighting and upheavals came in rapid
succession. If we wished to know the reasons, we would find that
they were caused by persons of society who did not follow their
conscience. For this reason we determine to get rid of anti-
revolutionists and pseudo-rebels from the country. To carry this
into effect, we should first deal with Lee Tsung Woo, the rascal.
To prove the genuineness of this statement, we only need glance
over the following list of crimes committed by him :-
(1) Biography of Lee Tsung Woo.
A native of Ningpo and a vagabond. At the end of the Manchu
reign he gathered and collected many loafers and terrorised and
defrauded the country folks, kidnapped women, harboured robbers,
open gambling dens and what not.
(2) Lee Tsung Woo at the time of the First Revolution.
Having committed numberless crimes, he was wanted in earnest by
the Authorities of his native place and escaped to Shanghai where
he bolstered up Chen Chi Mei, who made him Commander-in-Chief of
the Kwong Poh Chun (Republican Army). In the above capacity he
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界警务处。
警务总监办公室。
已归档
印刷传单的译文。
191......
致警务总监。
请阅读这篇关于一个冒充革命者的人所犯罪行的故事。
由于满清王朝的覆灭，革命爆发，并迅速将我国转变为共和国。这一变革的初衷是为了社会进步的利益，也是为了铲除坏人、安抚好人。出乎意料的是，在共和以来的这五年中，战乱和动荡接连不断。如果我们探究其原因，会发现这是由社会上那些不遵循良知的人造成的。因此，我们决心从国家中清除反革命分子和伪叛乱分子。为了实施这一目标，我们应首先对付流氓李徵五。为了证明本声明的真实性，我们只需浏览一下他所犯下的罪行清单：
(1) 李徵五传记。
宁波人，是个无赖。在满清统治末期，他纠集了许多游手好闲之徒，恐吓和欺诈乡民，绑架妇女，窝藏强盗，开设公开赌场等等。
(2) 第一次革命时期的李徵五。
因犯下无数罪行，他被家乡当局通缉，逃往上海，在那里他支持陈其美，陈其美任命他为光复军总司令。凭借上述身份，他

page_data.en:
HANGH.
CAI
2
began to collect his old colleagues and made a big
show of his power.
(3) Lee Tsung Woo in Military power.
While in full authority he committed himself very
improperly. He ordered his troops to loot as part of their
duty and despatched a portion of them to Haichow to
smuggle salt to Shanghai in order to enrich his own pocket.
Unexpectedly the ship that carried the salt sank in a storm
and some of the crew were drowned. Alas ! these innocent
and strong citizens should suffer death in their blind
endeavour to perform duty which was only to benefit the
self-aggrandising leader.
(4) Lee Tsung Woo at the time of the Second Revolution.
During this time when the rebels had failed everywhere
and had taken refuge in Shanghai, Lee in conjunction with
Wong Tsze Liang secretly planned with the Government detectives
to wantonly prosecute his partizans. For instance, the
betrayal of Wong Hyi Tsang ( 王雯章 ) by Tsang Lau Dah
( 章少良 ) and the assassination of Tsang Nyi Kong ( 張二綱 )
by Tsong Sau Liang ( 章少良 ). These cases are well-
known to the public that they were instigated by Lee.
(5) (A portion of this paragraph is not legible).
It says that Lee and a Divisional Commander of Troops
at Nanking obtained possession of over $50,000. for the
purpose of doing something, but they did nothing and
appropriated the money to their own use.
(6) Lee during the Third Revolution.
After the 3rd revolution when the rebel party came once
more into power, Lee Tsung Woo was in fear of being the
victim of revenge; so he allied himself with ex-Taoyin Chow
and with the prominent Yunan rebels planned to smuggle
opium into Shanghai to profit thereby. Unfortunately for
him the undertaking was discovered and the people
page_data.zh:
上海。
警察
2
开始召集他的旧部，大肆炫耀其权势。
(3) 掌握军权时的李徵五。
在他大权在握期间，行为极不检点。他命令部下以抢劫为职责的一部分，并派遣部分人员前往海州，将私盐走私至上海，以中饱私囊。不料运盐船在风暴中沉没，部分船员溺水身亡。唉！这些无辜且强壮的公民，竟在盲目地执行仅为了使那位追求个人膨胀的领袖受益的任务中丧生。
(4) 第二次革命时期的李徵五。
在此期间，叛乱分子在各处失败并避难于上海，李徵五与黄子良勾结，秘密策划与政府侦探合作，肆意起诉他的党羽。例如，章少良背叛王雯章（王雯章），以及章少良刺杀张二纲（張二綱）。公众皆知这些案件是由李徵五煽动的。
(5) （本段部分内容无法辨认）。
文中称李徵五与南京的一位师长获得了超过5万元，目的是做某事，但他们什么也没做，并将这笔钱据为己有。
(6) 第三次革命期间的李徵五。
第三次革命后，当叛乱党派再次掌权时，李徵五担心成为报复的受害者；因此，他与前道台周氏以及云南著名的叛乱分子结盟，计划将鸦片走私到上海以从中获利。不幸的是，该行动被发现，相关人员

page_data.en:
3.
concerned arrested and convicted, but Lee escaped
from being penalised by the law.
(7) Lee Tsung Woo of the present day.
After the death of Yuan Shih Kai, the former cons-
titution revived. Our Government remitted money to
Shanghai for the purpose of repatriating the revolutionists.
Profiting by this occasion, that rascal Lee bribed the
others to elect him on one of the examining staffs connected
with the Repatriation which post he did not hold honorarily.
Also, he sent his subordinates; Hsu Tsung Ah ( 许振亚 ),
Lee Lai Sung ( 李蘭生 ), Ting Sze Hsi ( 丁士杰 ),
Kau Ih Kew ( 高 - 得 ), Tseu Sing Ming ( 周醒民 ),
Yau Ping Ching ( 姚屏卿 ), etc. to place bombs on the
Sin Sze Kya roof garden, to threaten Wong Tscu-Cheu (黄楚九).
Nominally, he said that he would protect him on condition
that he would permit a performance to be staged at the Sin
Sze Kya and that the money realised from this performance
would be for the benefit of the revolutionists. In reality,
that money was proportionately divided between Lee and his
subordinates. By doing thus, they prevented the affair
dealing with repatriation from reaching perfection. Again,
that rascal Lee employed the name "repatriation" to ask the
Chamber of Commerce to subscribe several tens of thousands
of dollars, which he said he would be used for buying the
passage tickets. He spent only a small sum of money, the
remainder of which went into his own pocket.
(8) Lee's greediness and unsatisfied taste.
Lee was not satisfied with what he squeezed from the
passage tickets. He also cheated Yu Ya Ching to request the
Tien Zoen Wu Dah theatre to stage a performance in aid of
the revolutionists. By playing this trick he got another
sum equal to that which he gained at Sin Sze Kya, while the
revolutionists did not get a cash from the affair.
page_data.zh:
3.
被捕并定罪，但李徵五逃脱了法律制裁。
(7) 当今的李徵五。
袁世凯死后，旧宪法恢复效力。我国政府汇款至上海，用于遣返革命党人。那个流氓李徵五利用这个机会，贿赂他人选举他进入与遣返工作相关的审查机构之一，而他并不荣誉地担任该职位。此外，他派遣下属许振亚（许振亚）、李蘭生（李蘭生）、丁士杰（丁士杰）、高 - 得（高 - 得）、周醒民（周醒民）、姚屏卿（姚屏卿）等人，在新世界屋顶花园放置炸弹，以威胁黄楚九（黄楚九）。名义上，他说如果允许在新世界上演一场演出，他将提供保护，且演出所得收益将用于造福革命党人。实际上，那笔钱由李徵五及其下属按比例瓜分。通过这样做，他们阻碍了遣返事务的圆满完成。再者，那个流氓李徵五借用“遣返”的名义，要求商会捐款数万美元，声称将用于购买船票。他只花费了少量资金，其余部分则落入他自己的口袋。
(8) 李徵五的贪婪和不满足的欲望。
李徵五对从船票中榨取的利益并不满意。他还欺骗虞洽庆，请求天蟾舞台上演一场援助革命党人的演出。通过玩弄这个伎俩，他又获得了一笔与在新世界所得相当的款项，而革命党人从此事中未得到一分钱。

page_data.en:
4.

"Ah ! brethern, Shanghai is the metropolis of our country,
a place where the eyes of both the Chinese and Foreign residents
are focussed, and in that very place we find that ██████ rascal
employing his skill in plots and all the crimes he can commit.
Not only our country will suffer the evil consequences that
will follow, but the Foreigners will look down upon us. If
we do not get rid of that rascal soon, more evils will in
store for us. Brethern, brethern, rise up and get rid of that
vagabond at once.

(sd) The revolutionists residing at Shanghai.

There may be a Substance
of truth in certain portions
of the attached Circular
which "the revolutionists
residing in Shanghai"
have written in denunciation
of General Lee Tsung Woo
but although his reputation
is not very high he is not
by a long way the rascal
that he is painted in this
Document.
The writers are evidently
enemies of his who are
seeking for reasons of
their own to do him an
injury.

██████████ C
19 12/7/6
page_data.zh:
4.

“啊！同胞们，上海是我国的大都市，是中外居民目光聚焦之地，而就在这个地方，我们发现 ██████ 流氓施展其阴谋诡计，犯下各种罪行。这不仅会使我们的国家遭受随之而来的恶果，还会让外国人看不起我们。如果我们不尽快除掉那个流氓，更多的祸患将在等待着我们。同胞们，同胞们，奋起立即除掉那个无赖。

（签名）寓居上海的革命党人。

附上传单中由“寓居上海的革命党人”撰写、谴责李徵五将军的部分内容可能含有事实真相，尽管他的声誉不高，但他绝非这份文件中描绘的那种流氓。
作者显然是他的敌人，他们出于自身原因寻求伤害他。

██████████ C
19 12/7/6
